values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Natural Gas Intelligence article from April 2021 reports that the CJ Express expansion signed a firm transportation deal with Golden Pass LNG to supply feed gas to its terminal in Texas.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: An Oil and Gas Journal article from February 2021 describes the 48 inch CP Express pipeline from Jasper County, Texas, to the proposed CP2 LNG plant in Cameron Parish, Louisiana.

verifications.note: Article names CP Express as the pipeline feeding the CP2 LNG plant.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Sempra Infrastructure page says Cameron Interstate Pipeline links the Cameron LNG terminal in Cameron Parish, Louisiana, to five interstate pipelines. The 2017 expansion added flow toward Cameron LNG.

verifications.note: Page names Cameron Interstate Pipeline, its link to the Cameron LNG terminal, and 2017 expansion carrying gas to Cameron LNG.

records.researcher_notes: The page says the pipeline carries gas to Cameron LNG after the 2017 expansion, which added liquefaction feed gas. It also carries send-out gas from the terminal. Flag set because the expansion brings feed gas for export.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A December 2025 Arbo Research note says the Plaquemines LNG expansion would get feed gas from the roughly 300 mile Cloud Connector Pipeline in Louisiana.

verifications.note: Note names Cloud Connector Pipeline as the feed gas source for the Plaquemines expansion.

records.researcher_notes: The Energy Information Administration project list also says the line would feed the Plaquemines LNG terminal. The pipeline is proposed.
